# TP CIME – Electrical characterization report (Overleaf project)

* `main.tex` – compile with pdfLaTeX. Limit: 10 pages including cover and figures.
* `sections/` – one file per section. **`02_diodes.tex`: subsections 2.1–2.5 are for the diode I–V group** (orange boxes); 2.6 (diode C–V) is already written.
* Red `[...]` marks (`\tocheck{}`) = information to confirm (names, date, measured diode module, pad size).
* `figures/` – MDC screenshots + plots generated by `analysis/`.
* `data/` – raw MDC files (.MCV). `analysis/*.py` regenerate the numbers and figures (run from the project root, `python3 analysis/figs.py`).
